The magic runs from November 20 (Ice Skating at Harris Pavilion) through February 28, with the Holiday Family Day at Liberia House (November 28), the Santa Lights Manassas Tree Lighting (December 4), the Greater Manassas Christmas Parade (December 5) and the VRE Santa Train (December 12) along the way, plus three Nutcracker productions in December. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
